GitHubSearchRepositories.name: GitHubSearchRepositories
GitHubSearchRepositories.summary: Search for repositories by keywords and scope. The user can search all repositories on Github, owned repositories, or member repositories. When the keywords are not provided, the user can search for all repositories in the specified scope.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: The keywords to search for in the repositories. Default is search for all repositories in the specified scope.

parameters.name: search_scope
parameters.description: The scope of the search. Can be 'all' (all repositories on Github), 'owned' (only repositories the user owns), 'member' (only repositories where the user is a collaborator on). Default is 'all'.

parameters.name: max_results
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return. Default is 5, maximum is 10.

returns.name: repositories
returns.description: Each object contains id (string), name (string), owner_username (string), description (string), url (string), is_owner (boolean), is_member (boolean), and is_public (boolean).

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: If search_scope is not 'all', 'owned' or 'member'. If max_results is not between 1 and 10.

BankManagerSearchPayee.name: BankManagerSearchPayee
BankManagerSearchPayee.summary: Search for a payee by keywords.

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: A list of keywords to search for in the payee name.

returns.name: payees
returns.description: A list of dictionaries containing the payee_id (in the format 'P-XXXXXX') and payee_name of each matching payee.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The 'keywords' parameter is empty or contains invalid characters.

GmailSendEmail.name: GmailSendEmail
GmailSendEmail.summary: Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: cc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: send_at
parameters.description: The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: An array of local file paths of attachments.

returns.name: success
returns.description: An boolean value indicating whether the email was sent successfully.

exceptions.name: InvalidRequestException
exceptions.description: The provided email address in 'to', 'cc', or 'bcc' is malformed, any file path in 'attachments' is invalid, or the 'send_at' is not in the correct format.
